fields.name: Entity
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 (server notification system, case 0x2A = esv::timeline::BackgroundActorRequestOneFrameComponent) creates the component (bg3.exe+0x2DF4200) and stores the ls::uuid of the request's actor entity (bg3.exe+0x107E6F0), or the null Guid when the entity has none.

fields.name: Timeline
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 copies +8..+0x18 of the server request (its Timeline Guid). Script Extender's ecl TimelineBackgroundEntityRequest has the same first two members (Guid Entity, Guid Timeline).

fields.name: ActorGuid
fields.evidence: bg3.exe+0x2DF53B0 copies +0x18..+0x28 of the server request (the actor Guid of the timeline).
